mapper.insert: INSERT INTO habit_checkin (user_id, habit_type, checkin_date, count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{habitType}, CURRENT_DATE, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE count = count + 1, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, habit_type AS habitType, checkin_date AS checkinDate, count, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM habit_checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND checkin_date = #{date} ORDER BY id
